#summary Implementation examples

= Examples =

The examples below are found in SVN within the [http://code.google.com/p/amfast/source/browse/trunk/examples examples] directory. They implement a simple contact manager, with data persisted by SqlLite.

== CherryPy Example ==

Use CherryPy to serve the example address book over http with the following command:
{{{
python addressbook/python/cp_server.py
}}}
